summary: The note describes the Janáček Academy of Music and Performing Arts, one of two academies of music and dramatic arts in the Czech Republic. It is named after the composer Leoš Janáček and was founded in 1947. The note is very brief and gives no further details.
one_line: A Czech academy of music and performing arts, named after composer Leoš Janáček and founded in 1947.
